sample_unit: runs (3 LLMs x 4 schemas x 3 repetitions)

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM schema-mapping accuracy across repeated runs (strict AND match)
links.effect: AND Match consistency was 0.87 for DeepSeek, 0.64 for Gemini and 0.51 for ChatGPT; Gemini showed greater variability and ChatGPT lower consistency.
links.quote: DeepSeek obtained the highest numerical mean F1-scores (0.78-0.99) with strong consistency (AND Match = 0.87).

unlisted_practices: Human-in-the-loop validation of LLM-generated data mappings between common data models and FHIR

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of three LLMs for automating health data schema mapping (CDMs to FHIR R4) against a standardized reference set, analyzing error patterns and performance.
